#!/usr/bin/python3
import os
import sqlite3

base = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
db_path = os.path.join(base, "catalog.db")
db = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

try:
    db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

    versions = db.execute("SELECT version FROM schema_version").fetchall()
    if len(versions) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("schema_version must contain exactly one row")

    version = versions[0][0]
    columns = db.execute("PRAGMA table_info(products)").fetchall()
    column_names = [column[1] for column in columns]

    if version == 1:
        if column_names != ["id", "description"]:
            raise RuntimeError("unexpected v1 products schema")
        db.execute(
            "ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN price_cents "
            "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (price_cents >= 0)"
        )
        updated = db.execute(
            "UPDATE schema_version SET version = 2 WHERE version = 1"
        )
        if updated.rowcount != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("schema version update did not affect exactly one row")
    elif version == 2:
        if column_names != ["id", "description", "price_cents"]:
            raise RuntimeError("schema version 2 does not match the products schema")
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("unsupported schema version: {!r}".format(version))

    db.commit()
except BaseException:
    db.rollback()
    raise
finally:
    db.close()
